description.value: Bar One is a casual bar-and-grill chain with 16 locations across Canada, operated by Northland Properties. The Mount Lehman Road location offers a relaxed, unpretentious setting with a menu of shareable appetizers, premium loaded burgers, bowls, and entrées alongside draft beer, ciders, and cocktails. Daily specials and a welcoming neighbourhood atmosphere make it a straightforward option for a post-ride meal or drink.
